_meta.indication: JARDIANCE is a sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus

pivotal_trials.design: Multi-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; empagliflozin 10 and 25 mg vs placebo (primary objective) and sitagliptin 100 mg (secondary objective)
pivotal_trials.population: Drug-naïve adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus not optimally controlled (HbA1c >7.0% and <10.0%) on diet and exercise alone
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change in HbA1c from baseline to Week 24
pivotal_trials.n: Placebo 228, empagliflozin 10 mg 224, empagliflozin 25 mg 224, sitagliptin 223
pivotal_trials.result: Placebo-adjusted mean HbA1c difference at Week 24: empagliflozin 10 mg -0.72% (97.5% CI -0.89, -0.56; p<0.0001); 25 mg -0.83% (97.5% CI -0.99, -0.68; p<0.0001)

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; empagliflozin 10 and 25 mg vs placebo as add-on to metformin
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus not optimally controlled (HbA1c >7.0% and <10.0%) on ≥1500 mg/day of metformin
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change in HbA1c from baseline to Week 24
pivotal_trials.result: Placebo-adjusted mean HbA1c difference at Week 24: empagliflozin 10 mg -0.57% (97.5% CI -0.72, -0.42; p<0.0001); 25 mg -0.64% (97.5% CI -0.79, -0.48; p<0.0001)

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; empagliflozin 10 and 25 mg vs placebo as add-on to metformin and sulfonylurea
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus not optimally controlled (HbA1c >7.0% and <10.0%) on ≥1500 mg/day of metformin and at least 4 mg of glimepiride
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change in HbA1c from baseline to Week 24
pivotal_trials.result: Placebo-adjusted mean HbA1c difference at Week 24: empagliflozin 10 mg -0.64% (97.5% CI -0.79, -0.49; p<0.0001); 25 mg -0.60% (97.5% CI -0.76, -0.44; p<0.0001)

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; empagliflozin 10 and 25 mg vs placebo as add-on to pioglitazone alone or in combination with metformin
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus not optimally controlled (HbA1c >7.0% and <10.0%) on ≥30 mg/day of pioglitazone alone or in combination with metformin
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change in HbA1c from baseline to Week 24
pivotal_trials.result: Placebo-adjusted mean HbA1c difference at Week 24: empagliflozin 10 mg -0.48% (97.5% CI -0.70, -0.26; p<0.0001); 25 mg -0.63% (97.5% CI -0.85, -0.41; p<0.0001)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥5% incidence) were urinary tract infections and female genital mycotic infections. In pooled placebo-controlled data, urinary tract infection occurred in 7.6% (placebo), 9.3% (10 mg), 7.6% (25 mg); female genital mycotic infections in 1.5% (placebo), 5.4% (10 mg), 6.4% (25 mg)
target_moa: Empagliflozin is a selective inhibitor of sodium glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT-2), which reabsorbs the majority of glucose filtered at the glomerulus; inhibition decreases glucose reabsorption and promotes urinary glucose excretion

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; no new efficacy or safety issue rose to the level of requiring input from an advisory panel

description.text: Updated labeling with data on empagliflozin vs glimepiride as add-on to metformin in type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on metformin

citations.quote: S-001 proposes to update the Jardiance labeling with data from Study 1245.28, a randomized, double-blind active-controlled study comparing empagliflozin to glimepiride in patients with type 2 diabetes and insufficient glycemic control despite metformin treatment.

description.text: Added labeling describing efficacy/safety of empagliflozin plus metformin combination in drug-naïve type 2 diabetes patients (Study 1276.1)

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application proposes to amend the Jardiance prescribing information with new information describing the results of Study 1276.1 entitled, “A 24-week phase III randomized, double-blind, parallel group study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of twice daily oral administration of empagliflozin + metformin compared with the individual components of empagliflozin or metformin in drug-naïve patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus.” Additional changes proposed in this supplement include new text describing results of a UGT interaction study.

description.text: Added a new indication to reduce cardiovascular death based on the EMPA-REG OUTCOME trial

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application proposes a new indication for Jardiance based on results of the cardiovascular safety study 1245.25, the EMPA-REG OUTCOME trial. It also updates the PI to comply with the Pregnancy and Lactation Labeling Rule (PLLRL).

description.text: Added indication to reduce risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in adults with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for revisions to the prescribing information (PI) to include a new indication to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in adults with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction.

description.text: Added EMPEROR-Preserved results and broadened the heart failure patient population (preserved ejection fraction)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for addition of new clinical study (EMPEROR-Preserved) results, and broadening of the patient population.

description.text: Added indication to reduce risk of sustained eGFR decline, end-stage kidney disease, cardiovascular death, and hospitalization in adults with chronic kidney disease at risk of progression

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for the use of Jardiance (empagliflozin) to reduce the risk of sustained decline in eGFR, end-stage kidney disease, cardiovascular death, and hospitalization in adults with chronic kidney disease at risk of progression.

description.text: Expanded indication to include pediatric patients aged 10 years and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for revisions to the Jardiance Prescribing Information and Medication Guide to include the additional indication "as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients aged 10 years and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus," based on the results from Protocol 1218-0091 titled, *A double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled, parallel group trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of empagliflozin and linagliptin over 26 weeks, with a double-blind active treatment safety extension period up to 52 weeks, in children and adolescents with type 2 diabetes mellitus*.

summary.text: Standard 505(b)(1) NDA submitted March 5, 2013 for empagliflozin to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes; initially given a Complete Response Letter on March 4, 2014 for product quality issues, then approved following a June 3, 2014 Class 1 resubmission. No advisory committee was convened. A cardiovascular outcomes trial (MACE) was required as a postmarketing requirement.
